convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'ADXDMI' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, and relies on external .mqh library TradeAlgorithms.mqh for all trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). The custom indicator buffers and the external library trading functions must be manually replicated.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA processes ticks

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans gate whether signal-reversal exits are active; when SellPosClose=true, a buy crossover signal closes short positions, and when BuyPosClose=true, a sell crossunder signal closes long positions

params.mm_mode_options: LOT=4 (fixed lots), FREEMARGIN=0 (fraction of free margin), BALANCE=1 (fraction of balance), LOSSFREEMARGIN=2 (fraction of free margin minus loss), LOSSBALANCE=3 (fraction of balance minus loss)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum controls interpretation: LOT mode treats MM as fixed lot size; other modes (FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) treat MM as a fraction of the respective margin/balance base. Default MMMode=LOT with MM=0.1 means 0.1 lots fixed.

custom_logic_notes: The entry logic uses a two-bar crossover detection pattern: Ind[1]>Sign[1] (previous bar Ind above Sign) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (current bar Ind crossed to at-or-below Sign from above) triggers buy entry on the crossover up from below, while Ind[1]<Sign[1] AND Ind[0]>=Sign[0] triggers sell entry on the crossover down from above. This is actually detecting a zero-bar crossover where the relationship was opposite on bar[1] vs bar[0]. The SignalBar input (default=1) determines which bar offset is used for signal detection; when SignalBar=0, the EA recalculates on every tick instead of only on new bars. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are derived from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, used by the TradeAlgorithms library likely for pending order placement or timing control. LoadHistory() is called each tick to ensure bar history availability. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans independently gate each of the four trade actions.
python_conversion_notes: The custom ADXDMI indicator must be ported or its buffer calculation replicated - without it, the EA has no signal source. The ADXDMI likely computes ADX/DI+ /DI- values with smoothing, so consider using the built-in iADX (MODE_PLUSDI, MODE_MINUSDI, MODE_MAIN) with a separate smoothing MA as a substitute. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose - these must be reimplemented with proper MT5 Python order sending (market buy/sell with SL/TP in price terms, not points). The MM/lot calculation from MarginMode enum needs full implementation. SL=1000 and TP=2000 are in points - must convert to price using symbol's point value. The CIsNewBar class must be replicated for bar-change detection. The crossover detection uses bar[1] vs bar[0] comparison which is standard and straightforward to port.
